messages.subject: Re: convert nested for loop to parallel
parts:
Dear Juan,

I'm sorry your question fell by the wayside. We appreciate all the questions that are posted and try to keep up with supporting everyone! Summer saw lots of travel among the nimble core team and we lost track of some query threads, and this was one. Sorry about that.

If it is still relevant, can you clarify your question? It is possible to parallelize nimble for entirely separate algorithm runs (e.g. MCMC for subsets of data or multiple chains for the same data). But it is not (yet) possible to parallelize computations within a model or algorithm. Does that help?

Perry

On Wed, Jul 17, 2024 at 7:18 AM Juan Xie <juan...@gmail.com> wrote:
Dear Nimble group,

I have one question regarding parallelization with NIMBLE: is it possible to parallelize nested for loop with nimble?

Specifically,  I have six regions D1,D2,...,D6 (# of locations are difference across regions), and for each region, I have multiple sets of observations. For a given region, I parallelize the NIMBLE pipeline for the 10 sets of observations by following https://r-nimble.org/nimbleExamples/parallelizing_NIMBLE.html.
My question is: is it possible to parallel the process across regions as well ? 

Thanks!

--
